content.text:
get_node	Read a node by id with depth-limited descendants.
    list_pages	List page ids + names. Result includes page_count, active_page_index, ids, and names as comma-separated strings.
    upsert_screen	Idempotently upsert a converted screen root and record it in the code-to-design conversion ledger.
    lint_document	Run first-class OpenPencil design lint over the active document. Optionally filter to a node subtree.
    export_design_md	Export design.md markdown, falling back to best-effort extraction when none is persisted.
    get_screenshot	Render a node to a PNG image for visual verification. nodeId may be "root" for the active page's top node.
    export_item	Export a page, arbitrary node, or current selection to base64-encoded image/PDF bytes.
    export_nodes	Export one or more nodes to base64-encoded image/PDF bytes. format is one of png|jpeg|webp|pdf.
    export_deck	Export the active page's boards as a presentation deck in PowerPoint, self-contained HTML, or PDF. Writes a file at outputPath; use export_item/export_nodes for base64 node-level exports.
    export_frames	Export every top-level frame on the active page into a directory, one image per frame, using the editor's own file naming.
    read_nodes	Read nodes with depth control. Omit nodeIds to return top-level page children; depth=0 truncates children to "...", depth=-1 returns full subtrees. includeVariables=true attaches variables/themes JSON strings.
    snapshot_layout	Get the hierarchical bounding box layout tree of the document. Use this to understand the current page structure, spatial arrangement, and node hierarchy before making changes.
    find_node_by_name	Locate the first node whose name matches (case-sensitive, exact) anywhere on the active page. Returns id + kind. ToolFailed when no match.
    get_node_parent	Return the parent id of node_id on the active page. parent_id=0 means the node is at the page root. depth is distance from root.
    get_node_children	List the immediate children of a node. Returns count + comma-separated ids + per-child (child_<i>_id/kind/name/x/y/width/height). Known leaves and empty containers return count=0 (NOT an error). Only an unknown node_id returns ToolFailed.
    count_nodes	Return total node count across all pages + a per-page breakdown. Result `per_page` is `;`-separated `index|count` records.
    list_node_kinds	Return a per-kind histogram of nodes on the active page (frame/group/rect/ellipse/polygon/line/text/path/other). Result `kinds` is `;`-separated `kind|count` records.
    set_node_hidden	Toggle a node's visibility (layer-panel eye icon). value is "true" to hide.
    set_node_locked	Toggle a node's lock (layer-panel padlock icon). value is "true" to lock.
    set_node_collapsed	Toggle a node's layer-panel disclosure state. value is "true" to collapse.
    set_node_rotation	Set node rotation in degrees on a node by id.
    set_node_text	Set text content on a Text-kind node by id. Rejects non-Text kinds.
    set_node_corner_radius	Set corner-radius (non-negative doc-px) on a node by id. Honored at paint time for Rect / Frame; other kinds accept the write but the radius is invisible.
    set_node_font_size	Set font size (positive finite doc-px) on a Text-kind node by id. Rejects non-Text kinds.
    set_node_font_weight	Set OpenType font weight (1..=1000) on a Text-kind node by id. Rejects non-Text kinds and out-of-range weights.
    set_node_stroke_hex	Set the stroke color on a node. Existing stroke gets its color overwritten; missing stroke gets a fresh 1 doc-px stroke attached at the parsed color so the change is visible immediately.
    set_node_stroke_width	Set the stroke width (doc-px) on a node. width=0 clears the stroke; width>0 on a node without an existing stroke attaches a fresh black-default stroke at that width.
    set_node_stroke_side_width	Set ONE side's stroke width (doc-px) on a node, leaving the other sides intact. Use for one-sided borders / underlines (e.g. side=bottom for an underline). Promotes a uniform stroke to its per-side form at apply time.
    set_node_fill_hex	Set the fill color on a node by id. Sister tool to set_node_stroke_hex; one-call color change without the other update_node fields.
    set_node_flip	Mirror a node horizontally / vertically. Pass any subset of flip_x / flip_y as "true"/"false"; omitted axes are left unchanged. At least one axis is required.
    add_node_effect	Append a visual effect to a node with default parameters. kind is shadow / blur / background_blur. Frame/Group/Rectangle and the leaf shapes accept effects; IconFont/Ref do not.
    remove_node_effect	Remove the effect at a 0-based index from a node's effect list. The list is cleared once empty.
    set_node_name	Rename a node by id. Empty names (after trim) are rejected so the LayerPanel never shows blank rows.
    toggle_node_selection	Shift-click parity: toggle node_id in the multi-selection (scoped to the ACTIVE page only). Already-selected ⇒ remove (anchor reassigns to last surviving id); otherwise add as new anchor. Rejects unknown ids and ids that live on a non-active page.
    set_active_page	Switch which page is the active target for subsequent inserts / batch_design / design_* commands. index is 0-based.
    add_page	Append a fresh page and switch the active page to it. Optional name and children mirror the TS MCP page tool. Returns false on id-space exhaustion or an empty name.
    rename_page	Set a page's display name. Accepts TS-style pageId or legacy index. Name must be non-empty / non-whitespace.
    delete_page	Remove a page by index or pageId. The applier keeps the active page valid (clamps if needed).
    remove_page	TS-compatible alias for delete_page. Removes a page by pageId or index.
    duplicate_page	Clone a page and switch the active page to the clone. Accepts TS-style pageId or legacy index; optional name overrides the clone name.
    reorder_page	Move a page. Accepts TS-style pageId + index or legacy from + to. Target is clamped to [0, page_count).
    insert_node	Create a new leaf node on the active or requested page. Accepts Rust flat fields or TS-style data object.
    update_node	Patch fields on an existing node. Accepts Rust flat fields or TS-style nodeId + data object.
    import_web_snapshot	Import a page snapshot JSON produced by the OpenPencil browser extractor script (getComputedStyle + layout boxes) as pixel-accurate absolutely-positioned nodes. The right path for SPA/complex-CSS pages.
    delete_node	Remove a node + descendants from its parent. Accepts Rust node_id or TS nodeId, plus optional pageId.
    move_node	Reparent a node. Accepts Rust node_id/target_parent_id or TS nodeId/parent, plus optional index and pageId.
    copy_node	Deep-clone a subtree with fresh ids under a new parent. Accepts Rust node_id or TS sourceId/nodeId, plus optional parent/overrides/pageId.
    replace_node	Swap an existing node at the same parent slot with a freshly-built leaf. Accepts Rust flat fields or TS-style nodeId + data object. Set drop_children=true to discard a container's subtree.
    insert_input_text	Insert a Text Input from the built-in UIKit onto the active page. Optional x/y doc-px floats place the top-left; defaults to (0, 0).
    insert_shadcn_input_text	Insert a Text Input from the built-in UIKit onto the active page. Optional x/y doc-px floats place the top-left; defaults to (0, 0).
    insert_shadcn_input_textarea	Insert a Textarea from the built-in UIKit onto the active page. Optional x/y doc-px floats place the top-left; defaults to (0, 0).
